Exploring the four packages and app shell to map implementation state, routing, and how they connect.

# Implementation State Summary

## Architecture Pattern (shared)

All three feature packages follow the same assembly model:

- Each exports a `RouteGroup` (`core_base`) with `GoRoute` definitions
- `apps/glasses_app/lib/app_router.dart` aggregates feature routes plus a root `/` home route
- Cross-feature navigation uses **route path constants** and **App-layer Provider overrides** (not direct feature-to-feature imports)
- Shared BLE/session state lives in `core_ble` (`bleSessionProvider`, `BleSessionListener`, etc.)

---

## 1. `feature_device_search` — BLE scan/search

**Path:** `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/device/feature_device_search`

### `pubspec.yaml`
Depends on: `core_base`, `core_ble`, `core_permission`, `flutter_riverpod`, `go_router`.

### `lib/` structure
```
lib/
  feature_device_search.dart          # barrel export
  src/
    device_search_controller.dart     # state + Notifier
    device_search_page.dart           # main view
    device_search_providers.dart      # onDeviceSelectedProvider hook
    device_search_routes.dart
    device_search_route_paths.dart
    widgets/device_search_widgets.dart
test/
  device_search_routes_test.dart
```

### Implemented

| Layer | Details |
|-------|---------|
| **State** | `DeviceSearchState` — `devices`, `scanning`, `errorMessage` |
| **Controller** | `DeviceSearchController` — permission gate, BLE availability check, 10s scan stream, dedupe-by-id updates |
| **View** | `DeviceSearchPage` — scan/stop controls, error banner, empty state, device list |
| **Widgets** | `DeviceSearchList`, `DeviceSearchEmptyState`, `DeviceSearchErrorBanner` |
| **Routing** | `/device/search` → `DeviceSearchPage` |
| **Integration hook** | `onDeviceSelectedProvider` — App overrides to navigate on tap |

### Missing / gaps
- No auto-scan on page open (user must tap Scan)
- No dedicated l10n (hardcoded English strings)
- No connect logic in-package — relies entirely on App override of `onDeviceSelectedProvider`
- Minimal test coverage (route group shape only)

---

## 2. `feature_device_connect` — BLE connect

**Path:** `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/device/feature_device_connect`

### `pubspec.yaml`
Same core deps as search (`core_base`, `core_ble`, `core_permission`, Riverpod, go_router). **No** `common_glasses_protocol`.

### `lib/` structure (minimal — 6 files total)
```
lib/
  feature_device_connect.dart
  src/
    device_connect_page.dart    # StatefulWidget, no separate controller
    routes.dart
    device_connect_route_paths.dart
```

### Implemented

| Layer | Details |
|-------|---------|
| **State** | Local `_busy` flag + `TextEditingController` for device ID — **no Riverpod Notifier** |
| **View** | `DeviceConnectPage` — shows pre-selected device card, manual ID field, Connect/Disconnect, link to search |
| **BLE** | Uses `bleSessionProvider` from `core_ble` for connect/disconnect; `BleSessionListener` wrapper |
| **Routing** | `/device/connect` — accepts `BleDevice` via `state.extra` |
| **UX** | Auto-`context.pop()` when connection succeeds |

### Missing / gaps
- **No dedicated controller/state model** — docs mark this as “not yet established”
- No tests
- No pairing/bonding flow beyond `bleSessionProvider.connect(deviceId:)`
- No l10n
- Thin feature: one page, no widgets subfolder

---

## 3. `feature_interpretation` — simultaneous interpretation

**Path:** `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/ai/feature_interpretation`

### `pubspec.yaml`
Richest dependency set: `core_ble`, `common_glasses_protocol`, `core_network`, `core_theme`, `record` (mic PCM), l10n generation.

### `lib/` structure
```
lib/
  feature_interpretation.dart
  src/
    config/interpretation_config.dart
    model/interpretation_state.dart, interpretation_entry.dart, interpretation_language.dart
    viewmodel/interpretation_controller.dart
    service/interpretation_language_service.dart
    routing/interpretation_routes.dart, interpretation_route_paths.dart
    view/
      interpretation_page.dart
      interpretation_entry_action.dart
      interpretation_error_message.dart
      widgets/ (language_bar, bottom_controls, entry_list, wear_reminder_toast)
    l10n/generated/...
assets/l10n/app_en.arb, app_zh.arb
test/interpretation_controller_test.dart, interpretation_language_service_test.dart
```

### Implemented

| Layer | Details |
|-------|---------|
| **State** | `InterpretationState` — `status` (idle/connecting/running/error), `entries`, `InterpretationError` with typed kinds |
| **Controller** | `InterpretationController` — BLE gate, mic permission, WebSocket ASR, PCM stream via `record`, glasses `setRecording` BLE command, streaming result merge |
| **Config** | `InterpretationConfig` + `interpretationConfigProvider` (must be overridden in App) |
| **Service** | `InterpretationLanguageService` — REST `languageList` via `core_network` |
| **View** | Full `InterpretationPage` with DesignTokens styling, language bar, entry list, mic start/stop, error display |
| **Entry** | `InterpretationEntryAction` — IconButton that `context.push('/interpretation')` |
| **Routing** | `/interpretation` → `InterpretationPage` |
| **l10n** | EN/ZH ARB + generated delegates |

### Missing / stubbed
- **App bar actions** — audio output and history buttons have `onPressed: () {}`
- **Language selection** — `_LanguageChip` `onTap: () {}`; swap only toggles local `_languagesSwapped` labels, **does not update** `InterpretationConfig.fromLanguageId` / `toLanguageId` sent to WebSocket
- **`interpretationLanguagesProvider`** is watched/prefetched but **not bound to UI**
- Hardcoded credentials in `app.dart` (noted as ponytail/dev placeholder)
- PCM-only audio path (Opus noted as upgrade path)
- Wear reminder uses `glassesDeviceStateProvider.isConnected` while start gate uses `bleSessionProvider` — two connection signals

---

## 4. `apps/glasses_app` — app shell & routing

**Path:** `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib`

### `lib/` structure
```
lib/
  main.dart
  app.dart                    # ProviderScope overrides + MaterialApp.router
  app_router.dart             # GoRouter assembly
  glasses_app_tokens.dart     # DesignTokens + ThemeData
  app_shell/
    home_page.dart            # composes shell + recording page
    device_home_shell.dart    # overlays: BLE banner, settings/search/interpretation icons
    device_recording_page.dart # Lanhu-style device home UI (mostly static)
```

### Route definitions (`app_router.dart`)

| Path | Source | Screen |
|------|--------|--------|
| `/device/search` | `feature_device_search` | `DeviceSearchPage` |
| `/device/connect` | `feature_device_connect` | `DeviceConnectPage` |
| `/device/settings` | `feature_device_settings` | (also registered) |
| `/interpretation` | `feature_interpretation` | `InterpretationPage` |
| `/` | App | `HomePage` |

No `ShellRoute` or nested navigators — flat route list.

### App-layer wiring (`app.dart`)

Provider overrides that connect features:

1. **`bleServiceProvider`** → `FlutterBlueBleService()`
2. **`networkConfigProvider`** → AI gateway base URL
3. **`permissionServiceProvider`** → `PermissionHandlerService`
4. **`onDeviceSelectedProvider`** → push `/device/connect` with `BleDevice` extra
5. **`interpretationConfigProvider`** → WSS URL, auth, API key, REST headers

l10n: `InterpretationL10n.delegate` + Material delegates; locales `zh`, `en`.

### `HomePage` composition
- Wraps `DeviceRecordingPage` in `DeviceHomeShell`
- Passes connect/settings/search route paths
- Default `InterpretationEntryAction` in shell header row
- `DeviceRecordFab` as floating action (from `feature_device_record`)

### `DeviceRecordingPage` — mostly visual shell
- Design-matched static UI (hero, quick actions, feature grid, bottom nav)
- **Live data:** `bleSessionProvider.deviceName`, `deviceRecordControllerProvider.isRecording`
- **Stubbed:** R/L battery (fixed 74%), bottom nav (no navigation), most quick-action tiles, AI network banner, feature grid cards (only Settings wired)
- Comment notes interpretation entry moved to `DeviceHomeShell` header, not the “同声传译” quick-action tile

---

## How features connect today

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  Home["HomePage / DeviceHomeShell"]
  Search["/device/search\nDeviceSearchPage"]
  Connect["/device/connect\nDeviceConnectPage"]
  Interpret["/interpretation\nInterpretationPage"]
  BLE["bleSessionProvider\ncore_ble"]
  Glasses["glassesCommandSenderProvider\ncommon_glasses_protocol"]

  Home -->|push search icon| Search
  Home -->|push connect banner| Connect
  Home -->|InterpretationEntryAction| Interpret
  Search -->|onDeviceSelectedProvider\nApp override| Connect
  Connect -->|connect/disconnect| BLE
  Interpret -->|start/stop gate| BLE
  Interpret -->|setRecording| Glasses
  Connect -->|pop on success| Home
```

**Shared hub:** `bleSessionProvider` — connect feature writes session; interpretation reads it and stops on disconnect.

**No direct feature imports** between search/connect/interpretation; only App + Core packages bridge them.

---

## `docs/plans/README.md`

Index for versioned execution plans (when to create, naming, required sections). **No active plan** in that file specifically for these four packages — it’s process documentation only.

---

## Overall maturity snapshot

| Package | Maturity | Main gap |
|---------|----------|----------|
| `feature_device_search` | Functional scan UI + controller | App hook required; no auto-scan; thin tests |
| `feature_device_connect` | Minimal working connect page | No controller layer; no tests; docs say “not established” |
| `feature_interpretation` | Most complete — full ASR pipeline + l10n + tests | Language UI stubbed; several header actions noop; credentials in App |
| `glasses_app` | Assembly demo works | Home page largely static mock; flat routing; hardcoded secrets |

Per `docs/implementation-status.md`, interpretation spec is still **draft**; device connect/record/settings are marked **not yet established** at the platform level, while search and interpretation have substantive file implementations.
